scheme_name: Artificial Limbs and Assistive Devices Supply Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must possess a Disability Certificate or a UDID Card
Monthly income of applicant or parents/guardian must not exceed ₹8,000
Applicant must be a member of a BPL family or have a recommendation from the Collector or Sub‑Divisional Officer (Revenue)
benefits_summary: Provides artificial limbs or assistive devices worth up to ₹6,900, either free of cost for low‑income beneficiaries or at 50% cost for those with monthly income between ₹5,001 and ₹8,000.
